# Proverbs 6 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** My-son, if you-have-become-surety for-your-neighbor, you-have-struck your-hand for-a-stranger,

**2** You-have-been-ensnared by-[the]-words-of your-mouth, you-have-been-captured by-[the]-words-of your-mouth.

**3** Do this then, my-son, and-deliver-yourself, for you-have-come into-[the]-hand-of your-neighbor: go, humble-yourself, and-press-hard-upon your-neighbor.

**4** Do-not-give sleep to-your-eyes, or-slumber to-your-eyelids.

**5** Deliver-yourself like-a-gazelle from-[a]-hand, and-like-a-bird from-[the]-hand-of [the]-fowler.

**6** Go to the-ant, sluggard; see her-ways and-be-wise,

**7** Which has-no chief, overseer, or-ruler,

**8** She-prepares in-the-summer her-bread; she-gathers in-the-harvest her-food.

**9** How-long, sluggard, will-you-lie-down? When will-you-arise from-your-sleep?

**10** A-little sleep, a-little slumber, a-little folding-of [the]-hands to-lie-down —

**11** And-your-poverty will-come like-a-traveler, and-your-want like-a-man-of [the]-shield.

**12** A-worthless person, a-man-of iniquity, walks [with]-crookedness-of mouth,

**13** Winking [with]-his-eyes, shuffling [with]-his-feet, pointing [with]-his-fingers,

**14** Perversities [are] in-his-heart, devising evil at-all-times, contentions he-sends-forth.

**15** Therefore suddenly will-come his-calamity; in-an-instant he-will-be-broken and-without remedy.

**16** Six things YHWH hates, and-seven [are an]-abomination-of His-soul:

**17** Eyes haughty, a-tongue lying, and-hands shedding blood innocent,

**18** A-heart devising plans-of iniquity, feet hurrying to-run to-evil,

**19** A-witness-of falsehood [who]-breathes-out lies, and-one-sending-forth contentions between brothers.

**20** Keep, my-son, [the]-commandment-of your-father, and-do-not-abandon [the]-teaching-of your-mother.

**21** Bind-them upon your-heart continually; tie-them upon your-neck.

**22** When-you-walk-about it-will-guide-you; when-you-lie-down it-will-watch-over-you; and-when-you-awake it will-talk-with-you.

**23** For a-lamp [is] the-commandment, and-the-teaching [is] light, and-a-way-of life [are] reproofs-of discipline,

**24** To-keep-you from-[the]-evil woman, from-[the]-smoothness-of [the]-tongue-of [the]-foreign-woman.

**25** Do-not-desire her-beauty in-your-heart, and-let-her-not-capture-you with-her-eyelids.

**26** For on-account-of a-woman [who is a]-prostitute — up-to a-loaf-of bread; but-a-man's wife — a-precious life she-hunts.

**27** Can a-man scoop fire into-his-bosom, and-his-garments not be-burned?

**28** Or can a-man walk upon the-coals, and-his-feet not be-scorched?

**29** So [is] the-one-going to [the]-wife-of his-neighbor; not will-go-unpunished anyone touching her.

**30** They-do-not-despise a-thief when he-steals to-fill his-soul when he-is-hungry.

**31** And-when-found he-repays sevenfold; all [the]-wealth-of his-house he-gives.

**32** One-committing-adultery [with a]-woman lacks heart; a-destroyer-of his-soul — he [who]-does-it.

**33** A-wound and-dishonor he-will-find, and-his-reproach will-not be-wiped-away.

**34** For jealousy [is the]-rage-of a-husband, and-he-will-not-spare in-[the]-day-of vengeance.

**35** He-will-not-accept [the]-face-of any ransom, and-he-will-not-consent though-you-increase [the]-bribe.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **6:6**: Nemallah (ant) — one of the rare natural-world observations in Proverbs. The ant as wisdom teacher without needing external authority.

- **6:16-19**: Numerical proverb (x/x+1 pattern) — a common ANE literary form. The seventh item (sowing discord) receives climactic emphasis.

- **6:26**: Difficult verse. The contrast is between a prostitute's cost (bread) and an adulteress's cost (life). Not endorsing prostitution but comparing consequences.

— EMET
